name: Homogeneous Emission Estimator
definition: Estimates radiance in a medium with emission only ($\sigma_s = \sigma_a = 0$, $\tau=1$). The integral is $L(x, \omega) = \int_x^y \epsilon(x', \omega) dx'$.
summary: The Homogeneous Emission Estimator computes radiance from a purely emissive medium by uniformly sampling a ray segment, achieving zero variance for constant emission.
